title: VTA DIDs — Create — payload
description: Ask a Verifiable Trust Agent to create a key-role identity under an eligible DID method, from a key-role DID template. The VTA mints every key fresh by its role's custody rules and commits a routine update successor and the caller's recovery key (CONVENTIONS.md §4, §5). No caller-supplied key, key identifier, keyed document or existing history is accepted.

contextId.description: Context the identity belongs to. Its derived keys are derived under this context's base.

template.description: A key-role DID template (`schemaVersion` 3; CONVENTIONS.md §4). Its `keyRoles` layout fixes which keys are minted; its `document` supplies only non-key members.

templateContext.description: Context whose templates `template` is resolved against. Absent uses the global scope.

templateVars.description: Values for the template's variables, checked against its `requiredVars` and `optionalVars` by the VTA's renderer.

methodParameters.description: Validated against the method profile's `CreateParameters` schema (method-profiles/<method>.schema.json); a member it does not define is refused with `vta/dids:methodParameterUnsupported`.

dryRun.description: Compute and return the preview without writing anything but the plan (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1). Absent reads as false.

previewId.description: Apply exactly the plan a previous dry run of this same request returned, or nothing (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1); what every approval is bound to.

reason.description: Why the change is being made, for the audit trail and for the other approvers. Never published.

preview.description: Present when `outcome` is `preview`, `pendingApproval` or `awaitingRecoveryProof`: the plan, and what an approval is bound to.

newVersionId.description: Present when `outcome` is `applied`: the version identifier of the change. Pass it as the next change's `expectedVersionId`.

keys.description: Every key whose state this change sets or would set, after the change.
